title: fndn/ui design tokens
description: DTCG-flavoured token file. Each group carries a $type; each token a $value. A $value may be a single value or an object keyed by mode (light/dark). Color strings are oklch(). Shadows are arrays of layers; a layer color may alias another token as {color.name}.

$transitions.description: Named transition timings: name → [duration token, easing token or CSS keyword]. They become the motion-<what>-<name> utilities of the Tailwind preset.

$reducedMotion.description: Value under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Emitted into a media query in tokens.css and into the reducedMotion table for ports.

$rounded.description: Value in a rounded app: under [data-shape="rounded"] in tokens.css.
